result.summary: The page is a food delivery home screen that mostly renders correctly. The main visible defect is a loading spinner stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image even though the image itself appears fully loaded, indicating a stale or orphaned loading indicator. No other clear rendering breakages were found.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image although the image has already rendered, suggesting the loading state was never cleared or the spinner is orphaned.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loading indicator is hidden once the image load event fires, or remove the spinner when the card data is fully resolved.

issues.description: The search input placeholder text and delivery fee text are rendered in light gray on a light background, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) for normal text.
